title: Trino connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Trino source's settings, read by the native analytics family (`loams_connector_analytics::trino`, CN2 Task 17) over Trino's client REST protocol. A source only. `password` and `token` hold secret **names** (D189), exactly the manifest's `secrets`, and are exclusive.

url.description: The coordinator, `https://trino.example.com:8443`. Every `nextUri` must stay on it.

query.description: The query. Give it an `ORDER BY` so a resume after Trino has forgotten the page is exact (R17.9).

password.description: HTTP Basic's password; needs an `https://` url. The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

token.description: A JWT or OAuth 2 access token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

lossy.description: Columns whose mapping loses information and is accepted (R5.1), for example a `timestamp` without a zone read as UTC.

evolution.description: The schema evolution policy (see the schema-mapping guide).
